# The appointment letter Mum rewrote

Mum wrote the clinic asking for a callback window and a private place to discuss medication. Her letter is clearer than the collection of prompts I made last year. [[Care arrangements]] should link to her version and retire mine. Keeping every draft active would make improvement look like additional work.
